environment.description: Application deployed on EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023) running as systemd service under 'appuser'. ImageMagick 7.1.0-49 installed from EPEL with default policy.xml. Container-less deployment, Flask behind gunicorn with 4 workers. Instance has IAM role with S3 and DynamoDB access. Security group allows inbound 443 from ALB only. No additional sandboxing or filesystem restrictions beyond standard Linux DAC permissions (appuser owns /var/app/uploads).

config.imagemagick_policy: /etc/ImageMagick-7/policy.xml (default permissive - all coders enabled, no resource limits enforced)
config.filesystem: /var/app/uploads owned by appuser, no mount restrictions
config.network: full outbound internet access via NAT gateway
